label: Experimental feasibility probe — not a historical or production font

sample.location: first printed line, after es and before her
sample.geometry_note: Manual horizontal local baseline; identity plane, no asserted perspective recovery. Crop bounds are x454..574, y10..72. Initial visual review corrected windows at x39/67/96 to x45/71/98 and extended bottom from y68 to y72 to avoid cutting observed ink; no shape repair.
sample.selection_policy: Only components fully inside each manual x window, at least min_area and not touching crop boundary. No joins, gap filling, morphology, inference or smoothing.

glyphs.note: First letter of wohl; fractured strokes are possible.
Second letter of wohl; visible counter.
Third letter of wohl; ascender and right foot.
Fourth letter of wohl; narrow ascender.

acceptance.note: Conservative diagnostic acceptance, not typeface fidelity. Reject fragmented, merged, boundary-cut or threshold-unstable candidates. No font export even if individual outline candidates pass.
